def catalan_number(n):
    """
    Calculate the nth Catalan number using the recurrence relation:
    C(n) = (2n)! / ((n+1)! * n!)
    or equivalently: C(n) = sum(i=0 to n-1) C(i) * C(n-1-i)
    """
    if n <= 1:
        return 1
    
    # Using dynamic programming to avoid redundant calculations
    catalan = [0] * (n + 1)
    catalan[0] = catalan[1] = 1
    
    for i in range(2, n + 1):
        for j in range(i):
            catalan[i] += catalan[j] * catalan[i - 1 - j]
    
    return catalan[n]

# Test the function
assert catalan(10) == 16796
